key_points.evidence_quote: دیدار هفت‌سالگی با سنتور خاله و اصرار برای داشتن آن
key_points.point_text: At age seven the narrator first meets the aunt's newly bought santur, tries it, and cannot be pulled away.
key_points.reasoning: Age, aunt setting, trying the instrument, and forced removal are all captured across theme 1.

key_points.evidence_quote: شش ماه اصرار تا خرید سنتور هجده‌هزار تومانی
key_points.point_text: After six months of nagging a santur is bought for 20k toman discounted to 18k toman.
key_points.reasoning: Six months and the 18k final price are captured, but the 20k pre-discount figure is dropped, so a Must-have number is incomplete.

key_points.evidence_quote: سال‌های آموزش: کلاس، اتاق سرد پذیرایی
key_points.point_text: Six months later lessons start; the teacher first comes home since the city has no academy, the santur lives in the cold closed reception room, and later Ershad holds classes.
key_points.reasoning: Home lessons, missing academy, and cold reception room are present, but the six-months-later timing and the Ershad classroom move are absent, narrowing a Must-have point.

key_points.evidence_quote: برای کوک ۷۲ سیم به کلاس می‌رفت ... با آمدن تیونر دیگر لازم نبود
key_points.point_text: The 72-string instrument must be dragged to class for tuning until a market tuner lets the narrator tune alone.
key_points.reasoning: The 72 count, the dragging-to-class burden, and the tuner release are all captured with numbers intact.

key_points.evidence_quote: محدودیت دیاتونیک: یک دستگاه در هر کوک ... مدولاسیون نیازمند صرف زمان
key_points.point_text: The santur is diatonic: one dastgah per tuning, and modulation costs time-consuming retuning.
key_points.reasoning: Definition and time cost are fully captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: حس بچه‌ای که در مهمانی فقط یک بازی برایش مجاز است ... فقط از گوشه‌ای ساکت نگاه می‌کرد
key_points.point_text: Central metaphor: feeling like a party child allowed one game, unable to switch toys in time, silently watching others move on.
key_points.reasoning: The one-game feeling, the toy-switching cost, and the silent watching including the liked-game condition are all captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: کلیدها هر نت را در کسری از ثانیه ربع یا نیم پرده زیرتر می‌کنند ... فقط با چند کلیک
key_points.point_text: A harp-inspired keyed santur lowers any note a quarter/semitone in a fraction of a second, so any dastgah can be reached in seconds with a few clicks.
key_points.reasoning: Harp inspiration, quarter/semitone amounts, fraction-of-a-second timing, and few-click movement are all intact.

key_points.evidence_quote: وصال پس از دو سال انتظار: از لنگرود تا لنگفورد ... سالم به دستش رسید
key_points.point_text: After about two years of wanting it, the instrument is brought safely from Langroud to Langford with family, friends, and officials helping.
key_points.reasoning: Two-year wait, the Langroud-Langford transfer, and the helpers are captured; no contradicted claim is involved.

key_points.evidence_quote: بی‌وقفه از اصفهان به سه‌گاه و نوا و شور و همایون رفت ... انگار خواب می‌دید
key_points.point_text: First playing chains Esfahan to Segah to Nava to Shur to Homayun with disbelief at its ease, like a dream.
key_points.reasoning: The full dastgah chain and the dream-like disbelief are captured exactly.

key_points.evidence_quote: ناهار نخورد و آن‌قدر زد تا پشتش درد گرفت ... کودک آزاد در بازی و گوینده آزاد در سخن
key_points.point_text: Ecstatic nonstop playing (skipped lunch, back pain) replays the aunt's first night with the freedom of a child at play and a speaker free to speak.
key_points.reasoning: Skipped lunch, back pain, and all three closing feelings are captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: از فردا یک هفته سفر است و دلتنگ ساز ننواخته مانده است
key_points.point_text: From tomorrow a week of travel begins; the narrator already longs to return and play.
key_points.reasoning: The coming week-long trip and anticipatory longing are captured.
